remarks: This beautifully maintained Gambrel Colonial is full of natural light, charm, and thoughtful spaces-perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. Ideally located just minutes from downtown New Canaan's shops, restaurants, schools, parks, and library, it blends convenience with comfort across 5,712 sq ft. Inside, you'll find 5 bedrooms (plus a 6th on the 3rd floor level), 4 full and 2 half baths, a wrap-around porch, and a 3-car garage. The main level features a welcoming foyer, a bright living room with gas fireplace, a formal dining room, a chef's kitchen with large island, an oversized family room with sliders to the back deck, and a private office. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite includes a dressing room and spa-like bath with double vanities, whirlpool tub, and walk-in shower. Three additional bedrooms, two full baths, and laundry complete the second floor, with a bedroom and storage on the third. The walk-out lower level offers a game room with wet bar, a half bath, a tiered-seat home theater, and a legal studio apartment with full kitchen (including a dishwasher and full-sized refrigerator), built-in Queen Murphy bed, marble bath, and private entrance-ideal for guests, in-laws, or rental income. Don't miss this sunny, versatile gem in one of New Canaan's most sought-after locations!
